fields.context: The earthquake has cut Route 4 north of Bel Ravi to light vehicles. Informal checkpoints have been reported on both routes. Police presence is reduced because stations were damaged.

threats.threat: Road closure from landslide or aftershock
Loss of communications on the corridor

mitigations: Movements need approval from the Security Manager.
Daylight movements only, with hourly check-ins.
Share alerts with other agencies' security focal points.
fields.recommendation: Continue essential programme movements on Route 9 under approval and daylight rules; suspend non-essential travel on Route 4 until the road and checkpoint reports are clearer.
